manifest.name: dsh-slot-explorer
manifest.description: Browse every slot the DeepSeek Harness Web UI declares: registration options, props, key spaces, live occupants, and an interactive preview HUD.
manifest.author: longyi-0x0

readme.text:
[](https://github.com/longyi-0x0/dsh-slot-explorer/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

A slot atlas and live preview console for the **DeepSeek Harness** Web UI.

The Web UI is assembled from slots: typed seats that plugins register into. This plugin adds
a sidebar panel that documents every slot the running UI declares — its kind, scope, props,
registration options, key space, and a copyable example — and shows who currently occupies
it. A separate **slot tour** can drop a reversible marker into almost any seat, so you can
see where a slot actually renders before you write the plugin that fills it.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A slot's contract is spread across type declarations, owner props, factory children, key
tables, and replace risk. Settling a question such as "can I add a button to the composer,
or would I replace the composer?" normally means reading DSH sources or trying it and
watching the UI break. This plugin makes the contract browsable in the product itself:

- **Discover** — search 103 slots and 6 component factories, as a topology tree or A–Z.
- **Understand** — kind/scope docs, registration options, copyable `client.js` examples,
  key domains with occupied keys, owner and standard props, referenced types, hook context,
  and injected slot info.
- **Learn** — **Slot basics** in the panel header gives a primer on kinds, scopes,
  registration, and replace risk in place.
- **Inspect** — live occupants with registrant, id or key, order, priority, and active state.
- **Preview** — a tour HUD that renders placeholders in every seat, with safe additive
  switches for 16 seats and explicit replacements for single, keyed, and chain slots.
- **Stay local** — client-only: no host routes, no network calls, no persistence, no
  session-format change.

| At a glance | |
| --- | --- |
| Slots / component factories | 103 / 6 |
| Registerable slots | 60 |
| Kinds | 43 single · 40 list · 17 keyed · 3 chain |
| Catalog snapshot | DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 |
| Occupancy | Live snapshot from `ctx.slots.snapshot()` |

| Requirement | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x | Tested with Desktop/runtime `0.2.1-rc.5`. The same Web UI ships in `dsh web`. |
| Web UI with slots, layout, locale, and ui-primitives | The client module injects `slots`, `layout`, and `locale`, and reads the host's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` module for the whale mark; DSH ships them all. |
| Node.js ≥ 20 | Only for the development scripts. The installed plugin has no runtime dependencies. |

The catalog is a build-time snapshot. After upgrading DSH, rebuild to refresh it; the panel
still opens with the bundled snapshot if the live topology is unavailable.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:longyi-0x0/dsh-slot-explorer
```

Reload the profile (or restart DSH). **UI Slots** appears in the sidebar panel list; the
sidebar brand mark becomes a whale with a small eye badge at its top-right, and clicking it
toggles the tour HUD. The badge turns green while the HUD is open.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/longyi-0x0/dsh-slot-explorer.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-slot-explorer
```

`client.js` is committed, so a checkout needs no build step and no dependencies. A `link:`
install uses the directory as-is, which is convenient while editing the plugin.

The package is not published on npm yet.

Open **UI Slots**. The header shows whether occupancy is **Live** or read from the bundled
**Catalog**, with a refresh button, and offers **Slot basics** — a primer on kinds, scopes,
registration, and replace risk that closes on Escape, the backdrop, or its close button.

The panel is bilingual (English/Chinese) and follows the host locale immediately. It uses
only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so it matches the active theme and light/dark mode.
Click the whale brand mark at the top of the sidebar (or **Start slot tour** in the atlas).

- The HUD lists **all 103 slots**, grouped into seven areas: frame, overlay, sidebar,
  settings, main/plugins, conversation, and right panel.
- The header shows enabled / total, **Show all** (the 16 safe additive seats only),
  **Hide all**, collapse to a pill, and close. A filter narrows the rows.
- Each row shows a kind glyph, status dot, slot name, a key selector or input for keyed
  slots, a locate button, and a switch. A region header has its own switch for every slot
  in that region, including replacements.
- **Safe additive** previews cover list slots and empty single slots. Adding a placeholder
  never covers shipped UI, so these are the only rows **Show all** turns on.
- **Replacement** previews are explicit: occupied singles, structural or navigation
  singles, and chains need the row switch (or the detail page's **Replace temporarily**).
  Keyed slots need a key; the HUD offers keys seen in the live occupants, or a free-text
  input when no key is known.
- Placeholders are display-only spans: a green border, translucent green fill, green text,
  and an eye. They are not clickable and have no close button. Inserting or locating one
  pulses green.
- Restore by turning o

The tour is a developer preview, not a settings surface. Additive slots can make shipped
navigation or list controls render a placeholder with no real behavior; an arbitrary keyed
key may never be dispatched by the host; a guarded keyed slot can reject the registration.
Those outcomes are expected.

| Data | Source | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Slot catalog, docs, options, examples, props | `CLIENT_SLOT_API` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner` from the installed DSH bundle, snapshotted at build time (0.2.1-rc.5) | The panel cannot show a catalog; it is embedded in `client.js` |
| Topology | Captured from the Slots Inspect Provider and stored in `src/topology.json`; embedded in `client.js` at build time | The bundled topology is used |
| Live occupancy | `ctx.slots.snapshot()` at runtime, the same method the shipped Slots Inspect Provider uses | Falls back to the bundled catalog and shows the **Catalog** badge with a retry action |

`ctx.slots.snapshot()` is not a public business service method. The code checks
`typeof` and wraps the call in `try/catch`; if a future DSH version removes it, the catalog
and topology remain browsable.

Append `?slot-explorer=static` to the page URL to force the static fallback, which is
useful for verifying that path.

- The catalog is a build-time snapshot of the installed DSH. Rebuild after upgrading DSH.
- The plugin does not probe the DOM or highlight a slot's real bounding box; the layout map
  is schematic.
- Search, filters, expansion, and selection are not persisted; reopening the panel returns
  to the overview.
- Tour state is not a setting. Page reload, plugin unload, leaving the tour, or restarting
  DSH removes every placeholder.
- Live occupancy is a snapshot taken when the panel opens or refreshes; there is no global
  polling.
- The plugin has no Host API, makes no network requests, and has no model-visible effect.
- Replacing shipped UI can leave the page in a state that only a reload or restart fixes.

The repository has no dependencies. Node.js ≥ 20 is enough.

```bash
npm run build    # rebuild client.js and src/data.generated.js from the installed DSH
npm run check    # artifact consistency + smoke test
npm run smoke    # render the panel against React/Cordis stubs
npm run check:artifacts

`npm run build` reads the installed DSH app bundle
(`/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar` by default), merges
`src/topology.json`, and concatenates the maintained sources:

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/head.js` | Bundle header, i18n dictionaries, icons, shared helpers |
| `src/body.js` | Atlas panel, tour HUD, preview controller, slot registrations |
| `src/topology.json` | Captured slot topology (maintained) |
| `src/data.generated.js` | Generated catalog payload |
| `client.js` | Generated self-contained browser bundle |

Options: `--asar <path>` for another DSH installation, `--topology <path>` for another
topology capture, and `--out <path>` for another bundle destination. On non-macOS hosts,
pass `--asar` explicitly.

`npm run smoke` evaluates `client.js` with a minimal React/Cordis/loader stub. It covers the
overview, a detail page, the A–Z view, the static fallback, the sidebar tour toggle, the HUD
listing all 103 slots in seven areas, collapse/expand, region switches, row restore,
single/keyed/chain replacement, **Show all** staying additive-only, and **Hide all**.

CI runs the artifact check, the smoke test, and `npm pack --dry-run` on Linux, macOS, and
Windows with Node 20, 22, and 24.

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | Self-contained browser bundle loaded by the Web UI |
| `index.js` | Empty Host half; exists only to mount the Client half |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile |
| `icon.svg`, `locale/*.json` | Plugin-manager metadata |
| `src/`, `scripts/` | Maintained sources and rebuild/smoke scripts (not in the npm tarball) |
